description: He wears a long deep plum patterned robe with gold geometric woven edging down the open front, at the long sleeve cuffs and lower hem, layered over a high-neck ivory undertunic with a short slit and narrow gold trim. A dark belt with gold motifs and a large circular metal buckle cinches the waist. A loosely folded ivory wrap with gold-brown ornamental borders and fringe drapes from a round shoulder brooch down the viewer-right side. Dark trousers and brown leather calf-high boots show below the robe; his bare hands are clasped in front.
